---
id: {ticket_id}
type: stm
category: {instance-defined category}
status: active
score: 0.00
base_weight: {instance-defined, 0.6–1.0 by category}
created: {YYYY-MM-DD}
updated: {YYYY-MM-DD}
links: []
# relations: hand-curated typed edges, 0–3 per key. Distinct from `links:` —
# that list is auto-generated by the scoring pipeline and carries no meaning;
# relations are written by the agent when it KNOWS two items are causally tied.
relations:
  unblocked_by: []   # items whose shipping/closing invalidates my blocked verdict — re-test when any of them moves
  blocks: []         # items waiting on me
  sibling: []        # same session / same root cause — read together when either is asked about
# unblock_when: REQUIRED whenever status is blocked/waiting/deferred.
# A testable condition + how to test it, one line. A blocked verdict without a
# test attached cannot be re-verified and WILL be repeated after it goes stale.
unblock_when: ""
tags: [{ticket_id 小寫}]
summary: "{ticket 簡述}"
---
